title: Can anyone give me a good action or suspense-thriller to watch that I might not have seen?

commenti.body:
[Oldboy](https://www.filmaffinity.com/en/film262430.html) 2003

If you're not into foreign subtitled films there's a US remake but I can'tvouch for that.

If you want something crazy and wild, try:

[Crank](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0479884/) 2006

Not everyone agrees it's good but nobody thinks it's boring
The remake is fine nothing special

A Bittersweet Life - one of the best, and most underrated, action thrillers from South Korea’s modern renaissance era. With a great neo-noir lead performance from Lee Byung-hun.

Green Room - lean, mean and nasty as fuck. Not high on the action quotient, but every minute is super tense and when shit goes down, it’s hectic. Punk band vs Neo Nazis in a confined setting… what could go wrong?

13 Assassins - a badass samurai film from Takashi Miike that sees 13 samurai trying to protect a city from an entire army. A good film, with the end siege being an all-timer set piece in terms of samurai movies.

A Prophet - basically the French Godfather, set inside a prison. Doesn’t really have much in terms of action, but is super tense and enthralling throughout with a masterful lead performance. And there’s an attempted prison cell assassination scene that is one of the tensest sequences I’ve seen in the 21st century.
I haven't seen the remake, but I've heard it doesn't hold a candle to the original _Oldboy_. The original, however, is a perfect thriller imo. Unbelievably great ending.
The remake is atrocious and we should all do our best to forget it even exists.
I can vouch for all of these, but I have a special place in my heart for 13 Assassins.
See that’s more accurate to what I’ve heard but didn’t want to sound harsh lmao. Haven’t bothered to give it a chance
